title: Retro Console Secrets Revealed

scenes.text: Why did the Dreamcast launch with a built‑in modem?
Sega added a 56 kbps dial‑up modem to enable online play before broadband was common.
scenes.label: 56KBPS ONLINE MODEM

scenes.text: The console’s VMU screen could display extra game info, acting as a second handheld display.
scenes.label: SECOND SCREEN VMU

scenes.text: Its GD‑ROM discs held up to 1 GB, double the capacity of standard DVDs at the time.
scenes.label: 1GB GD‑ROM DISC

scenes.text: Follow to stay ahead of the tech curve.
scenes.query: follow call to action tech channel

description: Explore three surprising features that set the Dreamcast apart in the late‑90s. From online play to a second screen, discover why it was ahead of its time. Follow for more hidden tech stories!
